title: ReTouch
subtitle: Touchscreen keeps working while you drive. Use at your own risk.
description: Normally the touchscreen stops working once the car moves, and you have to use the control knob. This app keeps the touchscreen on while driving. WARNING: it removes a safety feature meant to limit distraction. You use it at your own risk and are responsible for driving safely; no claims are accepted. Remove it in the Store to restore the stock behaviour.
